_note: school (optional): abjuration, conjuration, divination, enchantment, evocation, illusion, necromancy or transmutation. English or (accent-free) Spanish names are accepted. It changes no rule: it decides which particles and sound the spell is CAST with (the damage type already decides those of the impact). Without it, the usual generic effect. mode:"attack": attack roll (1d20 + casting ability + proficiency) against the target's real AC, just like a weapon. Required fields: id, dice. level 0 = cantrip.
name: Fire Bolt

_note: mode:"save": the TARGET rolls their own saving throw (saveAbility) against the caster's DC (8 + proficiency + castingAbility). halfOnSave (default true) decides whether passing the save halves the damage or negates it entirely.
name: Sacred Flame

_note: aoeRadius (optional, in blocks): hits everything within that radius of the impact point, with real terrain occlusion (a wall blocks it, see AUDIT.md) — you don't need to look directly at anyone. Without this field, the spell targets only whoever you are looking at.
name: Fireball

_note: concentration:true (default false): casting it replaces any previous concentration; taking real damage forces a Constitution save (DC = max(10, damage/2)) or the effect is lost.
name: Spirit Guardians

_note: mode:"heal": no attack roll or save. "dice" CAN add the caster's ability with $wis/$str/etc (unlike attack/save damage, which in 5e never adds an ability). With no target in sight, the caster is healed.
name: Cure Wounds
